sn8.4:1.1: Ekaṃ samayam āyasmā Ānando Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati Jetavane Anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme || || 2.
sn8.4:1.2: Atha kho āyasmā Ānando pubbaṇha-samayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaram ādāya Sāvatthiṃ piṇḍāya pāvisi āyasmatā Vaṅgīsena pacchāsamaṇena || || 3.
sn8.4:1.3: Tena kho pana samayena āyasmato Vaṅgīsassa anabhirati uppannā hoti || rāgo cittam anuddhaṃseti || || 4.
sn8.4:1.4: Atha kho āyasmā Vaṅgīso āyasmantam Ānandam gāthāya ajjhabhāsi || ||
